anomalies.observed: U1 (MAX3485) uses footprint 'Package_SO:SO-8_5.3x6.2mm_P1.27mm', which is a wide-body SOIC-8 footprint.
anomalies.expected: The MAX3485 is an 8-pin narrow SOIC-8 (3.9x4.9mm) device; the library part's own footprint filter specifies 'SOIC*3.9x4.9mm*P1.27mm*'. A matching narrow SOIC-8 footprint should be used.
anomalies.impact: The MAX3485 IC will not fit the PCB pads, causing an assembly failure and preventing the serial servo interface from functioning.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a footprint mismatch for U1: the MAX3485 is assigned a wide-body SOIC-8 footprint instead of the required narrow SOIC-8, which would prevent the IC from being assembled.

Spec says "R6, R7, R8, R15 | 2k, 20k, 2.2k, 2.2k | Bias/pull network on the MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line." It doesn't specify which is which. So A is high, B is mid. That gives a differential of about 1.65V, which is > 200mV, so fail-safe idle high. But standard is pull-up on A, pull-down on B. If B were pulled down to GND, then A high (3.3V) would give 3.3V differential, A low (0V) would give 0V differential, which might be marginal. Biasing B to mid gives better noise margin.
